Research shows that farmers understand the extent of the financial support for agriculture policy, the policy of financial support for agriculture overall satisfaction with the wishes of its agricultural production and significant positive impact on the behavior, the more farmers learn Fiscal Policy, Fiscal Policy for the overall The higher the satisfaction, the stronger its agricultural production will, more prone to agricultural production and management behavior. The level of agricultural subsidies to farmers and agricultural production and management wishes behavior does not have a significant impact. The research goal is to optimize Fiscal Policy, Fiscal Policy means of strengthening the scientific and operability, perfect Fiscal Policy to provide decision-making.

articleTitle: Field isomorphism or group isomorphism: The strategic choices of electricity firms under the institutional constitutive pressures
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Under transitional economy, the policy-making process of Chinese electricity firms is influenced by both group's strategies and exterior institutions. Based on institutional isomorphism, this paper discusses the impact of institution on this type of companies. According to the research, we found out, for the electricity firms in China, both field isomorphism p and group isomorphism will exert impact on electricity companies' behavior; moreover, field isomorphism has more pressure relatively.

articleTitle: Contagion or interdependence: An application to the stock markets using unconditional cross-market correlations
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, we consider stock market contagion as a significant increase in cross-market linkages after a shock to one country or group of countries. Under this definition we study if contagion occurred from the U.S. financial crisis to the rest of the major stock markets in the world by using the adjusted correlation coefficient approach which consists of testing if average cross market correlations increase significantly during the relevant period of turmoil. We would not reject the null hypothesis of interdependence in favour of contagion if the increase in correlation only suggests a continuation of high linkages in all state of the world. The majority of our results based on conditional correlation suggest contagion, but these results are biased though. Conditional correlation not only suggests contagion for all the countries in the sample, but also indicates no contagion but interdependence at the same time; this is clearly a lack of robustness.

articleTitle: Job satisfaction and demission of university faculties: Important factors and age difference
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Job satisfaction, an attitude studied in the organizational behavior, reveals a person's overall evaluation on his or her job. This research aims to find out the present situation of job satisfaction among the university faculties. Some important factors which lead to their dissatisfaction or tendency of demission and the age difference revealing from these issues will be included. The results reveal that among the three age groups, younger group (born in from 1980 to 1991), mid-aged group (born in from 1966 to 1979), and elder group (born in from 1954–1965), the younger the generation, the higher job satisfaction is. Self-development, self-realization, and satisfactory social interaction became the most important factors while the job's degree of the difficulty became the least important factor. The research also indicates an asymmetry in important factors of job satisfaction and of demission. At the same time, the effects of pressure and payment self-growth, self-realization, sense of dignity on job satisfaction are significantly different among the groups, which reveals a great difference among different age groups.

articleTitle: A study on the genetic evolution of dynamic core capability of advanced manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Firstly, the paper summarizes the studies of domestic and foreign scholars about dynamic core competence, defines the constitution of dynamic core capability of advanced manufacturing enterprises, analyses the characteristics of genetic evolution of dynamic core capability of advanced manufacturing enterprises. Based on this, build an genetic evolution game model of dynamic core capability of advanced manufacturing enterprises, and finally by analyzing susceptibility and dependence of the initial conditions of genetic game, analyze and summarize how dynamic core capability factors influence the decision-making process of game, which can provide a strong reference for Chinese advanced manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: Optimization on reference space of Mahalanobis-Taguchi System based on hybrid encoding genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The Mahalanobis-Taguchi System (MTS) is a new classifying and diagnostic technique of pattern recognition using a collection of methods of Mahalanobis distance, orthogonal arrays and signal-to-noise ratios. The advantages of MTS, such as the ability of choosing the effective variables, no need to make assumptions about data distribution and high classification speed, etc., make it a wide range of applications in areas, including industrial production, business management and pattern recognition. However,as a relatively new classification method, it is also controversial to construct a reference space by using the method of orthogonal arrays and signal-to-noise ratios. For the shortage of MTS, an optimization model of reference space is constructed by hybrid encoding genetic algorithms, built decision model which aimed to minimize the error rate of classification and maximize the signal-to-noise ratio, then give the initial solution to the problem by using uniform distribution strategy, and then the method of genetic algorithm is introduced to obtain further improvements. The experiment results show the good convergence and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Research on technological innovation mode selection in the context of low-carbon economy
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In order to study the decision-making mechanism of technological innovation mode in the context of low-carbon economy, definite open innovation and closed innovation as policy set and build game model of low-carbon technological innovation mode selection based on evolutionary economy. Then analyze the evolution dynamic stability of strategy selection. Finally demonstrate the impact of different initial conditions and decision parameters on evolution results. The result shows that when competitive benefits are greater than input costs of open low-carbon technological innovation, the system may evolve to the situation that all the potential adoptive companies choose open innovation strategy or all companies choose closed innovation strategy, which is determined by the initial ratio of companies of choosing the two strategies. In addition, carbon tax and absorptive capacity are two important factors of the system evolution.

articleTitle: Research on risk evaluation of low-carbon technology innovation in Chinese manufacturing under the conditions of globalization
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Taking the impact of globalization into account, the process of low-carbon technology innovation in Chinese manufacturing (LCTICM) is divided into three main phases: global low-carbon R&D, global low-carbon manufacturing, global low-carbon marketing and the risk factors of each phase are deeply analyzed. On this basis, the risk evaluation index system of LCTICM under the conditions of globalization is constructed. In addition, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method based on triangular fuzzy numbers are combined and used to evaluate the level of LCTICM risk under the conditions of globalization. The results show that the overall risk of LCTICM under the conditions of globalization is above the medium and the risk of global low-carbon R&D is slightly higher than that of global low-carbon manufacturing or marketing. In closing, a ranking of the evaluation results is provided as a reference guide for the selection and implementation of measured responses.

articleTitle: Study on fund performance to various measures: Evidence from UK market
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Both the micro ability to stock selecting and market timing are important to fund managers. Traditional measures for mutual funds performances are very sensitive with the bias, resulting from the variation of risk and risk-premium with time. In order to balance these kinds of variations, lagged public information factors may be helpful. Including short-range UK Treasury Bill (Rf) and dividend yields (DY), different fund returns are predicted with additional information. This paper empirically estimate the average performance of 68 UK close-end mutual funds invested in domestic market over a meaningful decade-period from 2000 to 2010, applying the traditional and conditioning versions of capital asset pricing model and Fama-French model. Meanwhile, Jensen's (1968) traditional strategy and conditional measure of Ferson and Schadt (1996) are involved followed by a set of time-series regressions in order to compare different measure's significance in T test and F test. The findings are that CAPM not only has higher fitness butt also decreases the minus bias of market timing when adds conditional information. However, FF models show contrast evaluation and unexpected inferior outlets based on UK mutual funds between 2000 and 2010.

articleTitle: The effect of health shocks on Chinese urban household assets portfolio behavior
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper study the effect of health shocks on Chinese urban household assets portfolio behavior by PROBIT and TOBIT model, using newly data from China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). In particular, we investigate the influence of health shocks on a household's prabability of various assets and on the share of total assets held in each asset class. The results show that health shocks have a significant effect on urban households assets portfolio. We find that households increase their ownership of financial assets. Chronic health shocks may also cause urban households to increase the holding of financial assets to deal with health risks, while acute shocks may cause households to reduce holdings of other physical assets and risky assets.

articleTitle: Funding liquidity and money market interest rate—New Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between funding liquidity and money market interest rates comprehensively. Different from previous literature, by discussing the funding liquidity demand and supply of Chinese financial system comprehensively and using four main categories of money market interest rates, this paper finds strong evidence that funding liquidity supply, measured by M2 and excess deposit reserve rate of commercial banks, funding liquidity demand measured by the change of A-share accounts and fund raised by financial market greatly influence the money market interest rates of interbank lending and repo rates across different maturities. But SHIBOR is only sensitive to the change of funding liquidity supply factors rather than the demand factors. This paper also finds that funding liquidity affects market interest rates through market liquidity. The results of this paper provide reference for further interest liberalization in China.

articleTitle: The implementation of Renewable Energy policies—Wind energy electricity in Xinjiang autonomous region
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: China developed quickly and the energy needs are currently the largest worldwide. In order to build a wealthy, sustainable and harmonized society, China is in great need for reliable renewable energies. Although China has published the Law of Renewable Energy, the implementation of it meets some difficulties. The authors first introduce the current renewable energy policies, then take Xinjiang's wind energy policy implementation as an example. Xinjiang is a very resourceful province and it is one of the largest wind energy potentials of China. The development of renewable energy in Xinjiang were hampered by the decrease of interest in renewable energy due to other non-energy-related issues. This leaded to the fact that governmental officials did not focus much on the development of renewable energies and therefore renewable energy policies were not well implemented at all. Outdated facilities and techniques were other important factors that affect the implementation of renewable energy polices. The authors give some suggestions to solve the problems from this two perspectives.

articleTitle: Game analysis of technology innovation alliance stability based on knowledge sharing
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Technology innovation alliance(TIA) is an effectively pattern to improve enterprise technical level. Because of the incomplete contract, the technology innovation alliance is easily influenced by opportunism, benefit conflict and trust crisis. This paper adopts Cournot model and HPS strategy model to analyze the TIA stability. Cournot model is used in one-shot game, getting a Nash equilibrium. HPS strategy model is used in repeated game, getting the condition of TIA stability. Then this paper analyzes the influence of knowledge sharing from three parts-absorptive capacity, transfer capacity and knowledge repository in TIA stability. On this basis of analysis,the author probes into the condition of TIA stability. This paper provides theoretical basis and reference for those who expect to build alliance to promote profit.

articleTitle: Opening the black box: Business distribution in a group enterprise and Cash dividends
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Existing literature on factors influencing cash dividends has regarded the listed companies and their subsidiaries as a whole research object, and no studies so far has opened the black box of the lower level internal capital market. We present an interesting evidence that the business distribution in a group enterprise, specially, the business distribution between the listed company and its subsidiaries, and the diversification of subsidiaries, has a significant impact on cash dividends. Firstly, the more business distributed in the subsidiaries, the less cash dividends the listed company could pay. Secondly, for the group enterprise in which subsidiaries are the main business runner, the diversification of subsidiaries has a further negative effect on cash dividends of listed company. This paper shed a new light on how business distribution and internal governance in a group enterprise affect cash dividends of listed company.

articleTitle: Evolutionary research on the imbalance and polarization development of regional logistics
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Reconstructed the parameters of Gini coefficient, Wolfson index, Tsui-Wang index, ER index, Theil coefficient and Kanbur-Zhang index to analyze the evolutionary process of imbalance and polarization development of provincial regional logistics during 1985-2011. The results show that the regional logistics output transfers into imbalance stage from 1997, the imbalance degree of scale economic validity always stays at a high level; the polarization degree of regional logistics has been declining in recent years; combine with the comparative results, we can find the Northeast China is the key area for reducing the imbalance degree of regional logistics and the South China and Northwest China are the key areas for reducing the polarization degree of regional logistics.

articleTitle: The analysis of non-economic contributing factors in sustainable development capacity of reservoir migrants: A case study of Three Gorges engineering migration project
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With the development of hydropower in China, resettlement of affected population is becoming an increasingly diffcult issue and the sustainable development problem has also become a main problem of hydropower construction in China. Based on the concept of sustainable development capacity, this paper develops a set of framework for non-economic factors and measures these factors through interviewing migrants from the Three Gorges area in three cities of Hubei and Jiangsu province. This paper divides the non-economic contributing factors in sustainable development capacity of reservoir migrants into four aspects, including External Influential Factors, Internal Influential Factors, External Value Factors, and Internal Value Factors. Based on the above framework, the factors of importance and satisfaction in different areas were analyzed using quantitative data analysis. The results showed that the resettlement areas' environmental resources and infrastructure, cultural integration, cultural identity, people's network and other factors were given high scores in importance and satisfaction. However, in terms of the social supporting system, the satisfaction score was visibly low. The analysis of our survey data indicates the main reason for this was that the governments are lacking in consent to involve the migrants in the consulting process and the insufficient social support. These results can be used to improve the resettlement process in the future.

articleTitle: The research on the hypercycle-based hotel product strategic orientation
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: As the fast changing development of tourism accommodation sector, specifically of the hotel industry, the development of hotel product increasingly becomes the challenge. The purpose of this study is to analyze the important aspect of the improvement of hotel product strategy in china. First, this paper redefines concept, characteristics and type of hotel product based on the enterprise resource and market segmentation, and then predicts the development trend of hotel product. Second, grounded on the theory of hypercycle, it gives the hotel product strategic orientation in a hotel context. The hypercycle-based product strategy is a new notion. It is characterized by the self-enhancement, mutual enhancement and co-evolution of the hotel product hypercycle system, which including the inner operational catalysis cycle of single hotel product system, the catalysis cycle of the resources, ability and core competence in the system and the cross-catalysis cycle of hotel product systems. Moreover we make a deep analysis of the strategic choice according to the hypercycle-based product strategy.

articleTitle: Public attention and Xinjiang CPI - A empirical study based on Baidu search index
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In recent years, with the economic development of western China, the influence of Xinjiang CPI on national CPI is increasingly becoming great, so accurately predicting Xinjiang CPI has become very significant for the whole country. Considering this, this paper tentatively uses public attention based on Baidu search index to predict Xinjiang CPI. After clarifying the connections among public attention, Baidu search index, Xinjiang CPI from the theoretical aspect, the Baidu search index obtained from Baidu keywords automate recommendation function was synthesized to well measure public attention by stepwise synthetic method. Then this paper empirical analyzes the relationship between Xinjiang CPI and public attention based on Baidu search synthesis index. From the empirical result, the predicted average absolute error of the prediction model is 4.65%, meaning that public attention could well predict the fluctuation of Xinjiang CPI.

articleTitle: Evaluation of environmental technology innovation capacity of equipment manufacturing industry based on optimal combination weights
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Environmental technology innovation has become an inevitable choice of adapting to low-carbon economy and gaining competitive advantage for equipment manufacturing enterprises. The evaluation indicator system of environmental technology innovation capacity is constructed by referring to domestic and foreign literature and considering the influencing factors of environmental technology innovation,in order to objectively and exactly dig and evaluate environmental technology innovation capacity. The evaluation model of environmental technology innovation capacity is constructed based on optimal combination weights, and do empirical analysis on environmental technology innovation capacity and its influencing factors of Chinese equipment manufacturing industry in 2010. The results show that Expenditure on R&D, Full-time Equivalent of R&D Personnel, Patent Application, Sales Revenue of New Product, Product Output Value of “Three Waste” Comprehensive Utilization, Enterprises Funds have important effects on environmental technology innovation capacity; the environmental technology innovation capacity of Manufacture of Transport Equipment and Manufacture of Communication Equipment, Computers and Other Electronic Equipment is greater. Results have guidance functions in further analysis and refine the influencing factors of environmental technology innovation capacity of Chinese equipment manufacturing industry, thus provide theoretical and practical basis for promoting environmental technology innovation capacity of Chinese equipment manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristic and efficiency analysis of the Chinese Futures Markets
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With the development of the Chinese Futures Market and prevalence of futures contracts, people lay more emphasis on the efficiency of four Future Exchanges in China. How to evaluate the efficiency in an effective way becomes an important issue. This paper is based on the Nonparametric Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) and Malmquist efficiency index to make an overall analysis on the efficiency of four Future Exchanges in China from July 2010 to January 2014. The major innovation points about this paper lie in the following four areas: (1) The efficiency of every Futures Market is estimated and the extent of the resource utilization is designated. (2) A ranking of the four Futures Exchanges in order of efficiency is arranged, which provides a new method for the evaluation on the Chines Futures Markets. (3) The scale efficiency of the Chinese Futures Exchanges is calculated, and it gives an answer to the problem of the scale economy for Chinese Futures Markets. (4) The utilization of the Malmquist efficiency index is initiated to analyse the latest changes in the efficiency of the Chinese Futures Markets, and a complete information on the efficiency of the Chinese Futures Markets is provided.

articleTitle: Proactive personality and ambidextrous creativity: Assessing the mediating role of role breadth self-efficacy and the moderating role of support for creativity
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This research built a theoretical model and tested psychological process and boundary condition linking proactive personality to employees' ambidextrous creativity by introducing role breadth self-efficacy as the mediator and support for creativity as the moderator. Using survey data from 400 executives of start-up companies in China, we found that, as anticipated, proactive personality positively affected ambidextrous creativity. Role breadth self-efficacy fully mediated the effects of proactive personality on ambidextrous creativity. Support for creativity moderated the link between proactive personality and ambidextrous creativity: ambidextrous creativity was higher in response to high proactive personality when support for creativity was high. These results yielded important implications regarding how to improve managers' creative performance at work.

articleTitle: The mechanism research of Transactive Memory System influence enterprise team performance
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: As a knowledge management system which can help team members understand other's expertise and skills, Transactive Memory System(TMS) is of great significance to improve the level of the enterprise team performance. This study constructed a relational model between TMS and enterprise team performance, via some statistical analysis methods like factor analysis and regression analysis, doing confirmatory empirical analysis about the relationship between the TMS and team performance. Results show that transactive memory system has different degree of significant effect on team performance. The coordinate dimension is the most relative one to the team performance. Knowledge integration plays an intermediary role in the relationship between the TMS and the team performance. As a vertical team knowledge processing and integrating system, TMS can develop the stock of the whole team knowledge and make efficient use of it.

articleTitle: The construction and study of assessment system on intersubjective cognitive differences of NIMBY conflict–A case study of Julu landfill in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: NIMBY conflicts surface compensation or benefits due to poor communication and conflicts triggered, but it is the essence of government officials, experts, scholars and the public to the conflict surrounding the policy response to cognitive bias, this bias affects not only the behavioral intentions surrounding populace, but also actions that directly affect their behavior. Existing literature focuses on research priorities NIMBY conflicts origin, the causes and coping strategies, and research on the cognitive differences between the different actors in coping strategies less. Therefore, this study uses fuzzy Delphi method to construct a comprehensive set of actors in the conflict NIMBY cognitive differences assessment framework, in order to reveal the different actors of the NIMBY attitude of cognitive strategies to deal with the conflict, seeking to resolve the different strategies a true reflection of the surrounding population, and for the construction of the main conflict between the NIMBY behavior norms laid research base.

articleTitle: A study of impact on IPO pricing of auditors' reputation—Based on the empirical research of Chinese GEM companies
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: According to the Signaling Theory, excellent auditors have excellent auditing quality. The quality of accounting information from a listed company that hired an excellent auditor for its IPO auditing is more secure, hence favored by investors. This paper uses data from Growth Enterprises Market (GEM) listed companies as a sample, and establish an OLS multiple linear regression model to analyze the impact of auditor reputation and the IPO pricing of GEM listed companies. The results show that hiring a reputable auditors can improve the company's IPO issue price but cannot significantly affect underpricing of IPO. Overall, the auditor's reputation will have an important but relatively limited effect on the stock pricing. Thus, auditor's reputation needs further improvement. This paper empirically examines the relationship between auditor's reputation and IPO issue price as well as underpricing in China's GEM listed companies. It also enriches the scope of IPO study, which has a practical significance in reducing the current high-rate of IPO underpricing.

articleTitle: Research on positive and negative incentive method to active individual based on safety management: FRN evidence
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In the process of enterprise's safety production, human factor plays a more and more important role. According to the classification of personality psychology, taking the active individual as the research object, through the method of cognitive neuroscience experiment to make a comparative study of the effectiveness of the positive and negative incentives. The experiment based on the evaluation paradigm of responding task results, mainly adopting “tip - target - feedback” paradigm, through comparing the stimulates from two groups, in the block1,16 participants with active traits were asked to respond to the square of different positions on the screen in the prescriptive time through clicking the key. If the participants click the square before the ending, a coin would be given as a reward; otherwise, no rewards would be given. In the same way, in the block 2, if the participants don't click the square before the ending time, a punishment would be given; otherwise, no punishment would be given. Negative components can be used to analyze the feedback, FRN, reflecting the subjects themselves in the mind of positive incentive method and negative incentive method two kinds of incentive methods to assess potency. The results reflected that positive incentive has more accurate answers than that of negative incentive, and punishment has a more significant FRN waveform than that of reward, when the participants give a right answer, without given a reward has a more significant FRN waveform than that of having a reward. This demonstrates that positive incentive method has a better management effect than negative when it comes to active individual during the safety management.

articleTitle: The configuration of strategic human capital in innovative teams and competitive advantages of firms: The moderating role of team spirit
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper studies the basic configuration of strategic human capital in innovative (R&D) teams and explores the relationship between strategic human capital and firm competitive advantages. Based on theories of human capital and the resource-based view of firms (RBV), and by using team spirit and human-capital deployment as moderating variables, the study surveys 218 high-tech SMEs in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region with questionnaire and multiple regression analysis. The results show that the configuration of strategic human capital in innovative teams mainly includes: knowledge, professional skills, innovative ability, and team exclusiveness; strategic human capital of innovative teams accelerates firms' competitive advantages; team spirit has positive moderating effects on the relationship between strategic human capital and firms' competitive advantages, while the human-capital deployment has no significant adjusting effects. The study shows that, in today's “Big Science” era, through the cultivation of team spirit, strategic human capital in innovative teams can better promote a firm's competitive advantages, it also provides an perspective examination on how strategic human capital affects firms' competitive advantages as well.

articleTitle: Impact of employees' compensation satisfaction on slack work of private electronic manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With the employees of private electronic manufacturing enterprises as the respondents, a conceptual model of the relationship between compensation satisfaction and slack work is built and four hypotheses based on the model are proposed. Through the factor analysis, correlation analysis and multiple regression analysis of the questionnaire data, the conclusions show that there is a negative correlation between the five dimensions of compensation satisfaction and slack work respectively. Compensation fairness and welfare policy show more significant impact on slack work, while the dimensions that show more significant impact on slack work will be different when considering different personnel categories, educational backgrounds and age groups. Measures for pre-controlling employees' slack behavior are proposed accordingly in order to reduce the probability of employees' slack behavior and improve the operational efficiency of private electronic manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on ecological carrying capacity of mountainous counties in southern Qinling piedmont of Shaanxi: The evidence from Zhenan
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper takes Zhenan County as the analysis samples of mountainous counties in southern Qinling piedmont of Shaanxi, using the ecological footprint of the revised model estimates the ecological footprint and ecological carrying capacity of Zhenan. The result indicates that per capita ecological footprints of Zhenan reduce from 1.62 to 1.57 and the per capita ecological carrying capacity of Zhenan reduces from 1.69 to 1.58 from 2006 to 2012. From the Ecological footprint of ten thousand Yuan GDP declined from 2.51 to 0.82, the resource utilization of Zhenan increases gradually and the pattern of economic development continues to good trend. Ecological deficit of those counties mainly rooted in consuming of resource by mining, damaging to wetland and forest by urbanization and contaminating in earth and water by sewage. So considering the capacity, building access policy and compensation mechanism, developing new energy and tourism, and encouraging immigrant should be focused.

articleTitle: Separation of ownership from control and merger and acquisition
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: We construct a theoretical model to investigate how ultimate controlling owners use takeovers to extract private benefits at the expense of minority shareholders and further exam whether the separation of ownership from control results in value-destroying mergers and acquisitions empirically. We find that: First, the merger premium is higher for firms with greater separation of ownership and control in unconnected M&As and lower for firms with greater separation of ownership from control in connected M&As. Second, greater separation of ownership from control will result in lower value creation (lower CAR and lower change in operation performance). Our results are consistent with the views that the ultimate controlling owners have motivations and powers to extract private benefits at the expense of minority shareholders. Besides, we provide additional evidence to managerial agency, hubris and market timing hypotheses which interpret what drives value-destroying mergers and acquisitions.

articleTitle: Study on improving paths of industrial independent innovation capability and the selection method: From the perspective of industrial alliance
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The core innovation advantage of industrial alliance is the foundation and direction to improve industrial independent innovation capability. Firstly, the industrial alliance classification and corresponding functional orientation of industrial innovation is analyzed, and then, the improving paths of industrial independent innovation capability based on industrial alliance are designed. Secondly, identification index system of core innovation advantage of industrial alliance is constructed, as well as quantization standards and rules before building the selection framework of improving paths of industrial independent innovation capability. At last, empirical study on improving paths selection is conducted by taking key areas of new material industry in Heilongjiang province as an example. Generally, this research aims to provide theory and method guidance to improve industrial independent innovation capability through industrial alliance.

articleTitle: An estimation of the regional disparities in technical efficiency in China: An analysis based on stochastic frontier model
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: On the basis of a number of literatures, a great contribution of regional disparity is technical efficiency, as it were, efficiency improvement is the only factor of narrowing the regional disparities. So we can bring the inefficient situation to the analysis of the regional disparities. This paper estimates the provincial technical efficiency in China based on the panel data of 30 provinces during the period 1996-2010 with stochastic frontier analysis. The results show that the technical efficiency levels have been continuously in decline, and the regional disparities are obvious. The range of 30 provinces surpasses 30%,which is over 20% in eight economic zones. The rate of decline for the regions of higher technical efficiency is slower than the lower ones. That means the regional disparities are enlarging.

articleTitle: Combined moderating effect of achievement goal orientations in work stress
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Through Lazarus' cognitive appraisal lens, the paper focuses on both single and combined moderating effects of the achievement goal orientation in the mechanism by which work stress is generated. Based on the regression analysis of 744 samples, the results demonstrate that: Performance goal orientation and the combination of learning goal orientation and performance goal orientation can significantly moderate the relationship between job demands and work stress, but learning goal orientation has no significant moderating effect on the relationship between job demands and job strain. This paper discusses implications according to empirical results and gives suggestions for stress-relieving: Managers shouldn't use performance management tools overly, and shouldn't emphasize employee learning solely. Supervisors should guide employees toward learning under the condition of low performance pressure.

articleTitle: Construction and management study of China livable rural community: A governance perspective
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The issue of China livable rural community governance is discussed in this paper, mainly from the perspective of literature review. At first, relevant concepts and theories are introduced, that is, the connotation of China “livable rural community” is defined which can also be called as China “livable community of villages and small towns”, and community governance related theory is introduced. And then, governance of democratic countries is introduced. China's national conditions is different from that of democratic countries, thus, based on the analysis of the differences, comprehensive analysis and comparison of related research of Chinese scholars are made in the following, which mainly include the main problems and countermeasures of China “traditional rural community” construction and management, and China “rural elites governance” together with its deficiency. Finally, the mode of “synergy governance leaded by rural elites” is put forward and analyzed, whose goal is to pursue the mutual cooperation and synergy co-governance among government organizations, community autonomy organizations, community residents, and other stakeholders, and to achieve “1 + 1 > 2” synergy effect ultimately.

Author Keywords: livable rural community (or livable community of villages and small towns)

articleTitle: A behavioral study on the value of elasticity of marginal utility in environmental risks
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The choice of elasticity of marginal utility greatly affects time discount rate, and is thus key parameter in welfare analysis across generations. This research elicits the value of elasticity of marginal utility with a behavioral experiment. Participants make behavioral decisions under environmental risks the experiment. Through the use of iso-elastic utility function, we derive elasticity of marginal utility. We find that the value of elasticity of marginal utility much lower than those used in existing literature. In addition, we notice that and people tend to overestimate the subjective probability of environmental risks in the experiment. A lower value of elasticity of marginal utility based upon real environmental behavior suggests a lower time discount rate. This is more preferable to make ethically motivated decisions on the welfare distribution across generations, and is more consistent with public attitudes.

articleTitle: Research on triple helix of university-industry-government relations: Empirical evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The triple helix of university-industry- government relations has been accepted as an important determinant of innovation. Collaboration between academia and industry plays a vital role in the economic development of the industrialized countries. In order to maximize profit through such collaborations, it is important to have a healthy and fruitful collaboration. Science and technology (S&T) collaboration platform in East China is a new fashioned form. This paper examines the collaboration relationship and explores the influence of collaboration on high-tech firms. Following a survey of 552 high-tech firms and 56 universities, we find that high-tech firms can improve economic performance through the collaborations with universities on the platform. In addition, the main findings indicate that the economic performance of high-tech firms is positively related with the collaborated projects, i.e. the more collaboration, the better economic performance.

articleTitle: The relationship of macroeconomy and the Treasury yield curve: evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The joint behavior of the Treasury yield curve and macroeconomic variables is important for bond pricing, investment decision and policy making. The empirical analysis has been carried out for mature markets like U.S., and in this paper we focus on China, an emerging market with an immature bond market. Through the Principle Component Analysis, we extract the level, slope and curvature factors from the Treasury yield curve and inflation factor and real economic activity factor from a set of macro variables. Structural VAR model is used to analyze their relationship. The impulse respond result shows that the inflation and real economic activity have significant influence on the level, slope and curvature factors of yield curve, and vice versa. The monetary policy can affect the three factors of yield curve, but cannot be influenced by any of them.

articleTitle: Research on CEO compensation stickiness of Chinese listed companies—Empirical evidence from the different situations of profits and losses
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper studies the stickiness of CEO compensation by verifying the existence of asymmetric relations between CEO compensation and corporate performance in Chinese listed companies during 2005 to 2012, the results show that the marginal increase of CEO compensation in the case of corporate earnings to be significantly greater than the marginal reduction in the case of corporate deficit, which is tantamount to say that the stickiness of CEO compensation exists. Further research finds that the stickiness of CEO compensation in Chinese listed companies has not yet demonstrated significant time-varying trends; but there is sign of increased. We also find that the stickiness of CEO compensation can be suppressed by improving of regional marketization, shareholding system reform and diversified equity of state-owned companies, supervision of government, media and general public, and matrix control strategy.

articleTitle: The efficacy of voluntary leadership in environmental collective action
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Leadership mechanism is a key factor underlying the performance of collective actions. This study for the first time examines the effect of voluntary leadership on collective actions in the context of environmental problems. Two experiments differing in leadership mechanism were designed. 96 subjects joined the experiments and formed into 32 groups in every of the five rounds. Analyses show that subjects are highly committed to environmental collective actions. This commitment does not fade with time in both leadership mechanisms. Voluntary leadership is found a common phenomenon with high frequency. Further, we notice that voluntary and imposed leadership are the same in nudging followers' commitment in environmental collective actions, although voluntary leaders do donate more than imposed leaders. Our study suggests that the seemingly higher efficacy of voluntary leadership is on the burden of voluntary leaders. It is not a good mechanism design when the number of followers increases, not to speak of its higher consumption of resources.

articleTitle: External knowledge acquisition and innovation performance: The roles of intra-firm communication and innovation incentives
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In the era of open innovation, external knowledge acquisition and exploitation have been a strategic choice for improving the innovation of firms. Existing literatures have discovered a complicated relationship between external knowledge acquisition and a firm's innovation but it has failed to explain the mechanism behind this relationship. This study, based on the perspective that external knowledge needs to be internalized by internal firm practices, explores the effect of information communication and innovation incentives on the transformation from an external knowledge acquisition to firm innovation. Hierarchical regression is used to investigate this question through 489 large and medium-sized companies in China and the results show that the positive impact of external knowledge acquisition on firm innovation is partially mediated by within-firm communication and an innovation incentive policy.

articleTitle: Research on industrial organization of Chinese medicine based on SCP paradigm
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The development of medicine industry in China has made great progress. But compared with the international horizontal degree, the medical industry in China still has lower barriers to entry and higher barriers to exit. Based on SCP (Structure - Conduct - Proficient ) paradigm analysis, the paper analysis on medicine industry organization in China, and uses multiple linear regression model to analyze the influencing factors of medicine industry organization. It does empirical research based on the 1995 to 2011 years' data on medicine industry organization in China, and provide a basis for the relevant departments to develop medicine industry in China.

articleTitle: Research on the optimal path of product innovation diffusion model based on game theory
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, the optimal time paths of product innovation diffusion model based on game theory were studied. Firstly, a diffusion model of product innovations was formulated on the basis of some important key factors. Then, the Nash equilibrium of optimal time path was obtained by solving the system of product innovations. At last, the output and price of industries based on optimal time paths were studied in equilibrium framework. The paper's conclusion is that all prices in an industry move together at the same rate when all products in the economy are weak gross substitutes, preferences are homothetic, and firms face menu costs. All firms invest in productivity and reduce real prices in the closed loop Nash non-cooperative equilibrium. In the case of quadratic menu costs, the outputs of industries and the economy go up along S-shaped time path characteristic of diffusion of innovations.

articleTitle: Study on evaluation system of government debt sustainability of resource-exhausting regions
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 21th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Government debts of resource-exhausting regions have problems in the scale appropriateness and sustainability. The establishment of a scientific evaluation system of debt sustainability is an effective solution to control the accumulation of local government debt risks. In combination with the features of resource-exhausting regions, the paper proposes the government debt sustainability concepts of aiming to maximize the efficiency of debt capital allocation under constraints of the optimization of regional debt structures and promoting the virtuous cycle of regional economic development. A three-level systematic evaluation index system of local government debt sustainability is constructed, using the literature and expert evaluation. The establishment of a scientific evaluation system of debt sustainability is an effective solution to control the accumulation of local government debtrisks. In combination with the features of resource-exhausting regions, the paper proposes the government debt sustainability concepts of aiming to maximize the efficiency of debt capital allocation under constraints of the optimization of regional debt structures and promoting the virtuous cycle of regional economic development. A three-level systematic evaluation index system of local government debt sustainability is constructed, using the literature and expert evaluation.
